entries.content: Reviewed allocation today. Tech positions have grown to represent a larger share due to appreciation. Need to consider whether current weightings still align with original risk tolerance and time horizon. Market conditions shift and sector leadership rotates over time.

Went through my old statements from 2021-2022. The growth funds that had been crushing it for years dropped 30-40% in a matter of months. Took almost two years for some to recover. Made me realize how quickly things can change in concentrated sectors, even when everything looks unstoppable.
